title: tragia arabica
intro: Tragia arabica, commonly known as Arabica Horseweed, is a plant species belonging to the family Euphorbiaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and skin issues, due to its health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Tragia arabica include reducing pain and swelling, as well as exhibiting antioxidant and immune-modulating effects. The bioactive constituents responsible for its medicinal properties include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions.
